title: Magnesium Resorbable Membrane for Guided Bone Regeneration in Critical Size Defect Model in Rabbits-Histomorphometric Analysis
authors: Beitlitum, I., Rayyan, F., Slutzkey, G., Raz, P. & Sarig, R. Clin. Implant Dent. Relat. Res. 27, e70055 (2025).
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss NOVAMag (magnesium membrane, screw, SHIELD) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Mg-based membrane supports guided bone regeneration (GBR), and when used in combination with a bone graft, enhances the performance despite the gas accumulation associated with membrane degradation” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
